resources.string: Estimates short-video viewer-page encounters in apps you explicitly enable, using layout identifiers and scroll positions. Facebook additionally uses exact fixed interface-description matches; unmatched descriptions are discarded. TikTok optionally compares visible title/caption fields transiently using in-memory keyed tokens; raw values are discarded. Does not read input or message text, photos or video. Counts stay in encrypted storage on this device. Optional counter display has its own switch. Separately allowing experimental auto-scroll and pressing Start on the counter permits numeric playback-progress inspection and an upward swipe after an observed playback loop in supported viewers. Stop remains visible; leaving, locking, pausing observation or hiding the counter stops further swipes. Auto-scroll is off after service restart. Disable observation at any time in Attention Stats.
